title: Claude Code · Overview
description: Headline numbers for Claude Code: sessions, cost, waits on a human, rule-approved checks, latency percentiles and subagents. Logs and traces stream: claude_code.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Distinct sessions that made at least one model call

queries.query: SELECT count(distinct session_id) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name='api_request'

panels.title: Prompts
panels.description: One interaction span per prompt you typed

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.interaction'

panels.title: Total cost (USD)
panels.description: Sum of cost_usd on every api_request event

queries.query: SELECT round(sum(cost_usd),2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name='api_request'

panels.title: Cost per session (USD)
panels.description: Total cost divided by sessions with a model call

queries.query: SELECT round(sum(cost_usd)/count(distinct session_id),2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name='api_request'

panels.title: Waits on a human
panels.description: Times Claude Code stopped until you answered: permission prompts plus AskUserQuestion

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND source='user_temporary'
SELECT round(sum(duration)/3600000000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND source='user_temporary'

panels.title: Rule-approved checks
panels.description: Permission checks settled by your settings rules (source=config), no human involved

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND source='config'

panels.title: Avg rule-approved check
panels.description: Average time a rule-approved check took

queries.query: SELECT round(avg(duration)/1000000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND source='config'

panels.title: p95 time to first token
panels.description: 95% of model calls started streaming faster than this

queries.query: SELECT round(approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE),0.95)/1000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request'

panels.title: p99 time to first token
panels.description: 99% of model calls started streaming faster than this

queries.query: SELECT round(approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE),0.99)/1000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request'

panels.title: p95 model call duration
panels.description: Full model call, first byte to last

queries.query: SELECT round(approx_percentile_cont(duration,0.95)/1000000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request'

panels.title: p99 model call duration
panels.description: Full model call, first byte to last

queries.query: SELECT round(approx_percentile_cont(duration,0.99)/1000000.0,1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request'

panels.title: Subagents
panels.description: Distinct subagents (agent_id) that made a model call

queries.query: SELECT count(distinct agent_id) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> ''

panels.title: Model calls made by subagents
panels.description: Share of all model calls that came from a subagent

queries.query: SELECT round(100.0*sum(CASE WHEN agent_id IS NOT NULL AND agent_id <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(*),1) AS y_axis_1 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request'

panels.title: Waits on a human: permission prompts vs questions
panels.description: A wait is a question when its parent tool span is AskUserQuestion

queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN p.tool_name='AskUserQuestion' THEN 'Questions it asked me' ELSE 'Permission prompts' END AS kind, count(*) AS waits, round(sum(w.duration)/60000000.0) AS minutes, round(max(w.duration)/60000000.0) AS longest_min FROM "claude_code" w LEFT JOIN "claude_code" p ON w.reference_parent_span_id=p.span_id AND p.operation_name='claude_code.tool' WHERE w.operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND w.source='user_temporary' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY waits DESC
SELECT histogram(_timestamp,'1 day') AS x_axis_1, round(sum(cost_usd),2) AS cost_usd FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name='api_request' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Time to first token per day: p95 and p99 (s)

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp,'1 day') AS x_axis_1, round(approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE),0.95)/1000.0,1) AS p95, round(approx_percentile_cont(TRY_CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE),0.99)/1000.0,1) AS p99 FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.llm_request' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Waits on a human per day

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp,'1 day') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS waits FROM "claude_code" WHERE operation_name='claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user' AND source='user_temporary' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp,'1 day') AS x_axis_1, count(distinct session_id) AS sessions FROM "claude_code" WHERE event_name='api_request' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
